title: 第一章 网恋对象竟是清冷校花?
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

南城师范大学新生开学，校门口经济学院报道处人群挤得水泄不通。

临近中午，正是报道人数最多的时候，报道处的队列排了大约七八米长，队伍里的人齐刷刷地伸着头往前探去。

陈舟拎着行李箱站在队列的最后面，由于他父亲工作比较忙，就没来学校送他，可他也不怎么在意，便一个人来了。

见前面的人一直往前看，陈舟不免有些好奇，他们看啥呢？

但两个行李箱成功挡住了他的好奇心。

陈舟只好静静地排在队伍后面，没一会儿，就排到他了，他递过录取通知书，坐在前面的那个有些学姐开口了。

“你好，同学，是经济学院新生吗？”

学姐的声音如同山涧滴落的清泉，陈舟的目光猛地落在清冷的学姐身上，这音色好熟悉，有点像自己网恋女友啊，但他还是有些难以置信，毕竟真能有这么巧吗，迎新的是自己的网恋女友？

面前的学姐穿着一身奶白色娃娃领衬衫，学姐皮肤白皙，杏眼微圆，小巧的鼻子镶嵌在小小的瓜子脸上，配上这一身穿搭，端得是一副清冷系美少女的模样。

但是陈舟还是下意识否定了内心想法，毕竟柠柠性格应该像是夏天的小太阳吧，只是偶尔会有这种清清冷冷的感觉，这个学姐的样子有点不像柠柠吧。

他回了回神，打算接着试探一下，也不顾旁边人的奇怪，故意用平时跟她连麦时的语气说道。

“是哦，我是经济系的新生哦。”

果然，不出陈舟所料，那个清冷的学姐猛地抬起头，好看的眉眼中闪过了一丝不易察觉的震惊。

真的是她，没想到居然在这里遇到她了，怎么办？

陈舟压下心底翻涌的激动，平复了一下心情，开口道。

“学姐，我爸妈没来，能送我去学生宿舍楼那边吗？”

说完后，还故意晃了晃自己手里的两个包，还有两个行李箱。

眼前的学姐冲他眨了眨眼，开口道，声音除了声调，跟平时连麦几乎一模一样。

“好的，学弟。”

这下陈舟算是彻底放下心来，还真是这么巧？居然开学报道时候的学姐是我网恋对象。

“那我们走吧。”

俩人走后，上一个报道完的学生瞪大眼珠子，眼睁睁地看着这个清冷学姐拉着一个行李箱，去送刚刚那个男生走了，侧过头，看着自己老妈。

“妈，你能先回家吗？”

坐在张晚柠旁边的两个跟她关系不错的室友见报道的人走得差不多了，凑过去窃窃私语。

“不是吧，见色忘友？刚拉她来，就跟着一个学弟跑了？不过这学弟长得真帅！”

“不至于吧，柠柠可能就是单纯想帮帮忙吧，毕竟追柠柠的男生有多少了，她不都看不上吗？”

“喂喂喂，你跟她认识又不是一天两天了，她除了跟我们私底下玩的比较开，天天傻乐呵，对陌生人不都是冷冰冰的？”

“说来也奇怪，咋还能人前人后反差这么大呢？”

“学她姐的吧，她姐才是真的冷，话也不多。”

一瞬间，俩人脑子里都想起那张和柠柠一模一样的脸。

Page (1/3)

The freshman class at Nancheng Normal University has begun, and the reporting office of the School of Economics at the school gate is packed with people.

It was approaching noon, when the number of people reporting was the largest. The queue at the reporting office was about seven or eight meters long, and everyone in the queue stretched their heads forward.

Chen Zhou stood at the back of the queue with his suitcase. Because his father was busy at work, he didn't come to school to see him off, but he didn't care much, so he came alone.

Seeing the people in front of him looking straight ahead, Chen Zhou couldn't help but be curious. What were they looking at?

But the two suitcases successfully blocked his curiosity.

Chen Zhou had no choice but to queue quietly at the back of the queue. After a while, he was in line. He handed over the admission notice, and the senior student sitting in front spoke.

"Hello, classmate, are you a new student in the School of Economics?"

The senior's voice was like a clear spring dripping from a mountain stream. Chen Zhou's eyes suddenly fell on the cold senior. The voice was so familiar, a bit like his online girlfriend, but he was still a little unbelievable. After all, could it be such a coincidence that the one he welcomed was his online girlfriend?

The senior in front of her was wearing a milky-white baby collared shirt. The senior had fair skin, slightly round almond eyes, and a small nose set on a small face. With this outfit, she looked like a cool and pretty girl.

But Chen Zhou still subconsciously rejected his inner thoughts. After all, Ning Ning's personality should be like the little sun in summer, but she occasionally has this cool and cold feeling. This senior girl doesn't look like Ning Ning.

He came back to his senses and planned to test her again. Regardless of the strangeness of the people next to him, he deliberately spoke in the tone he usually used when talking to her.

"Yes, I am a freshman in the Economics Department."

Sure enough, as Chen Zhou expected, the cold senior girl suddenly raised her head, and a trace of imperceptible shock flashed in her beautiful eyebrows.

It's really her. I didn't expect to meet her here. What should I do?

Chen Zhou suppressed the excitement surging in his heart, calmed down, and spoke.

"Senior, my parents are not here, can you take me to the student dormitory?"

After finishing speaking, he deliberately shook the two bags and two suitcases in his hands.

The senior sister in front of him blinked at him and said, her voice was almost exactly the same as usual Lian Mai except for the tone.

"Okay, junior."

Now Chen Zhou was completely relieved. Is it really such a coincidence?Surprisingly, my senior sister when I was reporting for the start of school was my online dating partner.

"Then let's go."

After the two of them left, the student who had finished the previous report widened his eyes and watched helplessly as the cold senior sister pulled a suitcase and sent the boy away. He turned his head and looked at his mother.

"Mom, can you go home first?"

The two roommates who were sitting next to Zhang Wanning and who had a good relationship with her saw that the people reporting on the news had almost left, so they came over to whisper.

"Isn't it true? You forget your friends because of sex? Just after you brought her here, you ran away with a junior fellow student? But this junior fellow student is so handsome!"

"No, maybe Ningning just wants to help. After all, there are so many boys chasing Ningning, doesn't she look down on them all?"

"Hey, hey, you've known her for more than a day or two. Apart from having fun with us in private, she is silly and happy every day. Isn't she always cold to strangers?"

"It's strange to say, how can there be such a huge contrast between the people in front of us and the people behind us?"

"Let's learn from her sister. Her sister is really cold and doesn't talk much."

For a moment, both of them remembered the face that looked exactly like Ning Ning.
